prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit stretch of the Great Wall of China with worn brick paving, waist-high crenellated parapet, standard-height arched gate and stone steps, empty of tourists, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Chinese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, soft rose-gold hair styled in braided, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a silver round bell, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver necklaces. Hands and nails are part of the lattice.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both legs and both feet — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of ONE rebar sculpture, like a three-dimensional drawing made of thick ribbed steel rebar bars bent into the shape of the body: bundled and crossing rebar bars form every part of her figure — her chest, torso, both arms, both hands with every finger, and both legs and both feet are nothing but rebar, with no solid surface and no real limb, chest or skin anywhere; the rebar lines are heavy and overlapping in the middle of each part and the surroundings show through between them, with no concrete anywhere, each ribbed bar catching its own glint, built as one open lattice sculpture like a statue, with no real body, no skin and no flesh anywhere inside or beneath the rebar. Her two legs stay clearly separate all the way down, made of the same material to the tips of her toes, standing directly on the ground with a soft contact shadow. Everything below the collarbones is an open lattice with wide gaps, so the surroundings and their light show straight through between the lines, while her real face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh, and the rebar edge rises in a small raised step at the base of the neck.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same rebar lattice, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Thai person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, an elegant handsome young male face with a high nose bridge, a defined jaw, straight brows and a strong neck, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth golden-tan skin, a calm easy look, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a tin hammer head, a gold ship's anchor, a bronze round bell, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a lead teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered platinum rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her body carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red sculptural heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
